_comment: Curated, not live — see docs/research/12-ferry-dive-site-data-sourcing.md. No structured per-site dive database exists for Belize anywhere (government, scientific, or commercial). positionSource records how confident each coordinate is: 'osm' = a real tagged OpenStreetMap point (queried directly, not assumed); 'unesco-reserve-centroid' = the official UNESCO World Heritage component-area centroid for the reserve this site sits in, not the individual site's own precise position; 'atoll-landmark-approximate' = a real named landmark within the atoll, used as a stand-in center since no site-specific coordinate was found. depthMinM/depthMaxM/difficulty are null wherever no source found today gave an actual number/level — never invented.

sites.name: Great Blue Hole
sites.reserve: Blue Hole Natural Monument (Lighthouse Reef Atoll)
sites.description: A 300m-wide marine sinkhole, wall and cavern diving to 40m. PADI recommends Advanced Open Water + Deep Diver training.

sites.name: Half Moon Caye Wall
sites.reserve: Half Moon Caye Natural Monument (Lighthouse Reef Atoll)
sites.description: A dramatic reef wall dropping over 900m, considered one of Belize's premier dive locations.
sites.sourceNote: Description from belizeaudubon.org/hmcnm/; no explicit depth figures published there.

sites.name: Angelfish Wall
sites.reserve: Half Moon Caye Natural Monument (Lighthouse Reef Atoll)
sites.description: Named for its Gray Angelfish population; also Parrotfish, Horse-eye jacks, eagle rays and occasional sharks.

sites.name: Elkhorn Forest
sites.reserve: Half Moon Caye Natural Monument (Lighthouse Reef Atoll)
sites.description: A shallow site south of the western beach with elkhorn and lettuce-leaf corals and abundant reef fish.
sites.sourceNote: Description from belizeaudubon.org/hmcnm/ (described as shallow); no exact depth published.

sites.name: Tarpon Caves
sites.reserve: Half Moon Caye Natural Monument (Lighthouse Reef Atoll)
sites.description: Shallow option 9-15m or deep option 18-40m. Green tube sponges, black coral trees, large black groupers, garden eels, and stingrays.
sites.sourceNote: Depth range confirmed from belizeaudubon.org/hmcnm/ (30-50ft shallow / 60-130ft deep, converted).

sites.name: Eagle Landing
sites.reserve: Half Moon Caye Natural Monument (Lighthouse Reef Atoll)
sites.description: A shallow dive at the southeast tip of Lighthouse Reef Atoll — tropical reef fish, Queen Conch, stingrays, a vertical wall nearby.
sites.sourceNote: Description from belizeaudubon.org/hmcnm/, explicitly called suitable for any diver.

sites.name: The Aquarium (Long Caye)
sites.description: Named dive site at Long Caye, Lighthouse Reef Atoll.
sites.sourceNote: Coordinate is a real tagged OpenStreetMap point (sport=scuba_diving), queried directly via Overpass API.

sites.name: The Elbow
sites.description: A well-known named dive site at the southern tip of Turneffe Atoll.
sites.sourceNote: No site-specific coordinate found — positioned at Blackbird Caye (a real, centrally-located landmark within Turneffe Atoll, per Wikipedia) as a stand-in center for the atoll.

sites.name: Calabash Caye
sites.description: Named dive site at Turneffe Atoll.
sites.sourceNote: Same Turneffe Atoll stand-in center as The Elbow — see that entry's note.

sites.name: Stingray Motel
sites.description: Named dive site at Turneffe Atoll.
sites.sourceNote: Same Turneffe Atoll stand-in center as The Elbow — see that entry's note.

sites.name: Hol Chan Cut / Shark Ray Alley
sites.reserve: Hol Chan Marine Reserve (near Ambergris Caye/San Pedro)
sites.description: Belize's first marine reserve and one of its most popular, accessible dive/snorkel sites — a reef channel known for nurse sharks and southern stingrays.
sites.sourceNote: Coordinate is a real tagged OpenStreetMap point ('Hol Chan Cut', sport=scuba_diving), queried directly via Overpass API. Difficulty inferred from it being a widely-marketed beginner/snorkel-friendly site, not from a formal rating.

sites.name: Tobacco Reef / South Water Caye Cut
sites.description: A cluster of named sites (Tobacco Caye Cut, Shark Pit, South Water Caye Cut, Tobacco Reef) inside the South Water Caye Marine Reserve.
sites.sourceNote: Positioned at the reserve's official UNESCO World Heritage component centroid, not individual site coordinates — none were found published anywhere.

sites.name: Emerald Forest / Southwest Caye Wall
sites.description: A cluster of named sites (Southwest Caye Wall, Manta Wall, Emerald Forest, Long Caye Wall, and others) inside Glover's Reef Atoll.
sites.sourceNote: Positioned at the reserve's official UNESCO World Heritage component centroid, not individual site coordinates — none were found published anywhere.
